title: pyrus amygdaliformis var. heterophylla
intro: Pyrus amygdaliformis var. heterophylla, commonly known as Chinese pear, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus amygdaliformis var. heterophylla include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic and medicinal properties.
